description: Comune di Gaggiano publishes this inventory of registered buildings, titled Fabbricati attivi, through the Maggioli open data catalogue. The exact table metadata lists cadastral identifiers Sezione, Foglio, Particella and Subalterno, followed by Rendita, Consistenza, Categoria and Classe. The source therefore describes building records with cadastral category and class attributes. It does not define units or interpretations for Rendita and Consistenza in the reviewed metadata. Coverage follows the publishing municipality; geographic completeness has not been checked. Two separately identified CSV publications of this municipal registered-building inventory are grouped here. The additional publication is described as Fabbricati attivi IMU and has the same eight named cadastral fields; byte-level equivalence and observation-date equivalence are unverified. The package and CSV distribution declare CC BY 4.0. Metadata is publicly readable, but the reviewed source does not state file-use charges. The inspected schema provides no coordinates, geometry, floor-area units, structural properties or energy measurements. A specific simulation application is not documented, so no simulation method is assigned. The declared update frequency is weekly; operation has not been independently checked. Accuracy and individual attribute values remain unverified. The source supplies no explicit related-resource links. Only field and catalogue metadata were read; no building rows or file bodies were obtained.
